justification: RC's iterative decoding carries a summary of earlier reasoning forward so the chain can continue past the window; evidence is lab benchmark gains (HMMT 2025, 40% to ~70%), never a deployed setting.
Contribution is a verifier that iteratively queries medical corpora to judge reasoning traces; evaluated only on four lab benchmarks (MedQA, MedXpertQA), not in clinical use.
ModelSwitch routes generation across several LLMs using sample consistency as the switching signal; claims rest on seven lab datasets plus theory, no practice setting.
Proposes uncertainty-guided lookback decoding that decides when the chain should re-ground on the image instead of thinking on; validated on MMMU and five further benchmarks in the lab.
DOVA's claim is deliberation-first orchestration of a multi-agent platform (roles, three-phase pipeline); its evidence is an architectural ablation across seven system configurations.
Expert iteration retrains the model on proofs it found itself, an outer loop that changes the agent between rounds; evidence is lab miniF2F state of the art.
DDC couples consensus confidence with adaptive termination to cut tokens over 10x while leaving sampling shape intact; validated on five lab benchmarks. Runner-up: deliberative_search.
GRACE theorises the optimal granularity of the verifier that scores candidates (ORM versus PRM); its four claims are proved then corroborated on MATH-500, GSM8K and AIME in the lab.
SPEX changes how ToT branches are speculatively expanded and pruned to break the reward barrier; evidence is measured 1.2-3x speedups on an SGLang prototype across ToT algorithms.
An RL controller decides each round whether to stop sampling or buy more, an explicit halting and budget mechanism; validated in the lab against ASC and ESC baselines.
CAPS reallocates verifier compute (evidence seen per judgment, spread of comparisons) leaving candidate generation intact; validated on five lab benchmarks. Runner-up: verification_and_gating.
TrACE is a per-timestep adaptive-compute controller spending extra LLM calls only when rollout agreement is low; evidence is lab runs on GSM8K and MiniHouse.
METASCALE evolves its pool of meta-thought strategies with a genetic algorithm, rewriting the agent's own strategy set across attempts; validated on Arena-Hard and other lab tasks.
PAC-MCTS contributes a bias-aware pruning rule governing node expansion in search; validated on Blocksworld and ALFWorld with supporting ablations, no field use.
KACE separates what is stored from what is read back, organising distilled cards in an epistemic tree retrieved per problem; validated on AIME 2025, MATH-HARD and OlymMATH.
Recursive Meta Prompting has a proposer rewrite the prompt across rounds, an outer loop changing the agent's own instructions; formalised then measured on MATH and GSM8K in the lab.
SAIL runs MCTS over whole trajectories with VLM scoring, so the contribution is the branching search; evidence is lab and real-robot runs varying test-time compute over six tasks.
The artefact is an instrument, not a loop mechanism: a library, a benchmark scoring quality against cost, and a trajectory debugger; results are lab measurements on math and code tasks.
The claim is that refining each rollout by self-critique and self-correction beats resampling more; evidence is lab benchmarks AIME24/25, AMC, OlympiadBench and MATH500.
AirRAG expands five reasoning actions into a tree searched by MCTS to widen the solution space; validated on complex question-answering datasets in the lab.
An empirical audit of one named mechanism, sequential backtracking versus parallel sampling, deliberately compared under fixed compute on CountDown and Sudoku in the lab.
Studies overthinking, compute spent past need, and proposes self-training strategies that cut it; validated on GSM8K, MATH500, GPQA and AIME in the lab.
The credited lift is the harness arrangement itself: an Explorer-Definer two-stage pipeline plus a Reflective Orchestrator; evidence is the 400-task ARC-AGI-1 public eval set with ablation.
Formalises the generation-verification gap governing self-improvement across rounds; evidence is a controlled modular study varying model families, tasks and pretraining flops.
CBS alters step-level beam search itself: multi-model candidate expansion with perplexity consensus scoring; validated on six lab reasoning tasks. Runner-up: multi_agent_coordination.
